svg.title: CFAR federated exchange
svg.desc: A successful inline SFLP exchange: the Origin Key Service applies Policy, selects Target Domains and creates a Lease and SFLPs. The Origin Agent encrypts and transports the Envelope and FLPs. The Target Agent quotes them in a local Retrograde request. Its Key Service validates the SFLP and bindings and applies Policy before releasing LKAI.

g.aria-label: Apply Policy; Select Target Domains; Create Lease + SFLPs
Delivery may be; delayed or intermittent
Decrypt + verify SFLP; Match request bindings; Apply local Policy
